tier_reason: The README gives first-party Volo QPS only (350k, 440k Monoio-based internal build) 'under the same test conditions as Kitex (limited to 4C)', with no Kitex number, CPU model, rustc version or flags. The in-repo benchmark/scripts (bench.sh, env.sh, build.sh; 1KB Thrift echo, server pinned to 4 CPUs, concurrency 100-1000, cargo --release --features unsafe-codec) match the kitex-benchmark setup, but no hardware or toolchain is stated for the Volo run, so this is C, not A.

corrections.workload: Thrift echo RPC, 1KB body, server limited to 4 CPUs (4C), 'same test conditions as Kitex' (cloudwego/kitex-benchmark setup; the in-repo benchmark/scripts/env.sh uses body 1024 and concurrency 100-1000); the README does not say which concurrency the 350k figure comes from
corrections.caveats: The README hedges the comparison itself: "it is very unfair to compare the performance with the Go framework, so we will not focus on comparing the performance of Volo and Kitex ... I hope everyone can view it objectively" and "we'll only publish our own QPS data." The page gives no Kitex number. Kitex's figures under the matching setup are in cloudwego/kitex-benchmark scripts/reports/thrift.csv (last updated 2022-08-26; Xeon Gold 5118, server 4 CPUs, 1KB echo, Go 1.17.2). There Kitex does about 228-231k QPS, so Volo's 350k is about 1.5x (derived from page data). But Kitex-MUX reaches 396-410k at 400-1000 concurrency, above Volo's 350k, and the README does not say which connection mode or concurrency Volo used. The 440k Monoio figure is an unreleased internal build. The High Performance text dates from 2022-08-23 and has not been re-run since. No CPU model, rustc version or flags are stated for the Volo run. The in-repo benchmark (benchmark/scripts) covers Volo only, with no Kitex harness. GitHub detects only Apache-2.0, but the README and Cargo.toml say MIT OR Apache-2.0 (LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE both present). The baseline is Kitex (Go), which is itself cataloged, not a C++ incumbent.

notes: The claimed_speedup quote matches the README word for word. Treat the page as an implicit comparison: it names Kitex's test conditions but declines to give Kitex numbers. Last commit on main is 2026-08-31 (the record's 2026-09-23 is pushedAt, from another branch). Stars 2,626, not archived, not a fork. GitHub REST was rate-limited, so metadata came from GraphQL.
